motion_rule: the camera swings round him without stopping while he strides the aisle, so the shelves sweep across the frame every beat and his face stays to the lens; he carries the box and never works it standing; his head half the frame, never under a third, a low angle from 6.3; new shot size each beat, one action per beat; the picture fills the vertical frame with no bars
character: a small sand-coloured fennec with huge ears, deadpan
second_characters: ONE scrawny jerboa working the aisle at the lens, vaulting the shelves and hauling nuggets past his nose
props: ONE plain cardboard box with a golden mountain stamped on its side, carried under his arm
prop_continuity: the box stays plain and empty however much gold pours past; the tape ripped off at 2.9 never goes back on
environment: a parcel sorting hall at noon, shelves packed to the roof hard against both sides of a narrow aisle, no distance anywhere
light_events: hard noon daylight through the roof slots bars his ears every beat, cold rim both sides

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: dry chesty male voice, deadpan, even 4.4 syllables/sec, beats filled edge to edge
audio.pronunciation: ko-ROB-ka, o-be-SHCHA-la, zo-lo-TY-ye, GO-ry, KA-zhet-sya, GDE-to, za ug-LOM
audio.pacing: 0.4-3.5 one breath; the gap under one second; 4.4-7.0 one breath with no voice sound outside the lines; after 7.0 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: jaws open on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: hall roar, rollers rattling, tape ripping at 2.9, a rumble along the shelves from 4.4, gold hammering the shelf walls from 7.0

timeline.a: the camera swings round him as he strides the packed aisle, the box under his arm, shelves sweeping behind
he swings the stamped side of the box up to the lens without breaking stride
he hooks a claw under the tape on the move, the camera swinging to his other shoulder
the jerboa vaults off a shelf across the aisle in front of the lens
he rips the tape and throws the flaps wide on the move, the box plain and empty inside
he shakes the open box at the lens on the move and nothing comes out of it
gold bursts out of the shelf sweeping past at his shoulder, never out of the box
he wheels round after it on the move, the shelves tearing across the frame
the jerboa hauls a fistful straight past the lens and he drives after him down the aisle
he swings round the aisle corner after the fall, shoulder raking the shelves
the fall jumps the aisle and hammers both shelf walls past his ears, none of it near him
he thrusts the open box up into the falling gold on the move and every nugget skips off the flaps
a nugget the size of his head bowls past the lens and he throws himself out of its way
he slams the empty box into the lens, deadpan, gold pouring past behind

must_appear: one plain box with a stamped golden mountain; at 2.9 it opens empty; from 4.4 gold bursts out of the shelves past him, never out of the box; at 7.8 nothing lands in it; at 9.3 he slams the box into the lens
